## Efecto de μ y σ en la Normal

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false

par(
  mfrow = c(1,2),
  mar = c(5,5,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Colores
col1 <- "#1f4e79"
col2 <- "#2e7d32"
col3 <- "#b23a48"

# =====================================================
# EFECTO DE LA MEDIA
# =====================================================

x <- seq(-5, 15, length = 600)

plot(
  x, dnorm(x,0,1),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,0.45),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = expression("Efecto de " * mu * " (" * sigma == 1 * " fijo)"),
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

lines(x, dnorm(x,3,1), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x, dnorm(x,7,1), lwd = 4, col = col3)

# Líneas en las medias
abline(v = c(0,3,7), lty = 2, lwd = 2,
       col = c(col1,col2,col3))

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(expression(mu==0),
             expression(mu==3),
             expression(mu==7)),
  col = c(col1,col2,col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

text(
  7.5, 0.42,
  labels = "La curva se desplaza\nhorizontalmente",
  cex = 1
)

# =====================================================
# EFECTO DE LA DESVIACIÓN ESTÁNDAR
# =====================================================

x2 <- seq(-10, 10, length = 600)

plot(
  x2, dnorm(x2,0,1),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,0.45),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = expression("Efecto de " * sigma * " (" * mu == 0 * " fijo)"),
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

lines(x2, dnorm(x2,0,2), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x2, dnorm(x2,0,3), lwd = 4, col = col3)

abline(v = 0, lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "gray40")

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(expression(sigma==1),
             expression(sigma==2),
             expression(sigma==3)),
  col = c(col1,col2,col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

text(
  4.8, 0.42,
  labels = "Mayor dispersión\ncuando aumenta σ",
  cex = 1
)
```
